description: Capabilities for the main window and the optional 'audience' window (two-display Present Mode): core defaults (incl. event listen/emit for the presenter<->audience handshake and the app:close-requested save flow), the native dialogs (file open for imports, save for backup export, ask for the unsaved-changes prompt at close), and app-local-data file access. Crash-safe persistence (storageAdapter/atomicFile) writes NAME.tmp, renames it over NAME and keeps NAME.bak, so it needs write-text-file, rename, remove and exists on $APPLOCALDATA. Each scope lists BOTH $APPLOCALDATA (the folder itself — needed to create it on first run) and $APPLOCALDATA/** (everything inside). The audience window needs the same fs/media read access as main so it can independently resolve slide media. Custom Rust commands (close_ack, confirm_close, cancel_close, check_import_dependencies, ...) are app-defined and callable without extra permissions. Files the teacher picks through a dialog are added to the fs scope at runtime by the dialog plugin, which is what lets backup export/import and Bible import touch paths outside app data.
